quotes.author: རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དར་མ་རིན་ཆེན་
quotes.why: Gyaltsab Je's construal of the same lemma: the content is drawn from all three, condensed and extensive alike. Found by direct search.

quotes.title: རྣམ་བཤད་སྙིང་པོའི་རྒྱན།
quotes.author: རྒྱལ་ཚབ་དར་མ་རིན་ཆེན་
quotes.why: Gyaltsab rejects the weaker reading of the lemma — 'not contradicting all three' — as self-defeating, which is what p5's use of it presupposes. Found by direct search.
